title: transaction.stopped, v1
description: A StopTransaction. timestamp is StopTransaction.req timestamp. StopTransaction carries no connector id: connector_id is the one from the matching transaction.started, or null when octap did not see the start.

reason.description: StopTransaction.req reason (OCPP 1.6 Reason), or null when the charger left it out (OCPP then means Local).

id_tag.description: StopTransaction.req idTag, or null. Personal data: usually an RFID card UID. See README.md.
